newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins China ATM contract.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins China ATM contract.

text.p: Sweden's L.M. Ericsson said on Friday it had won its first Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) contract for the Chinese market with Beijing Broad Telecom Corporation (BBTC).
Ericsson said it will install ATM access nodes to be used for datacom and video services over and ATM network between the cities of Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou.
"This is a breakthrough order for Ericsson," Ericsson said in a statement.
"We are already a recognised leading supplier of fixed an dcellular telecom networks to the Chinese market. This order now gives us recognition as a supplier of datacom solutions as well."

BBTC, which is affiliated to the Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, will connect the Ericsson delivered ATM nodes to its own developed ATM backbone switches, which are deployed in a nationwide ATM trial network.
Ericsson said it would begin installations in July this year.
